retained_features.name: elevation_mean_m
retained_features.rationale: Primary gravitational potential; floodwaters accumulate in topographic minima.

retained_features.name: slope_mean_deg
retained_features.rationale: Hydraulic gradient driving runoff velocity; flat delta terrain (< 1.5°) impedes rapid drainage.

retained_features.name: twi_mean
retained_features.rationale: Steady-state Topographic Wetness Index ln(a/tan(beta)) indicating natural zones of water convergence.

retained_features.name: aspect_mean_cos
retained_features.rationale: North-South directional orientation of hillslopes relative to monsoonal atmospheric inflow.

retained_features.name: aspect_mean_sin
retained_features.rationale: East-West directional orientation of terrain facets.

retained_features.name: aspect_circular_var
retained_features.rationale: Directional dispersion of topography [0=collinear, 1=isotropic flat/chaotic plain].

retained_features.name: aspect_flat_fraction
retained_features.rationale: Proportion of completely flat sub-pixel cells (aspect = -1) characteristic of fluvial floodplains.

retained_features.name: plan_curvature_mean
retained_features.rationale: Transverse flow convergence (+) into natural depressions versus divergent convex ridges (-).

retained_features.name: flow_accum_log10_max
retained_features.rationale: Order-of-magnitude upstream contributing cells capturing regional drainage concentration.

retained_features.name: dist_to_river_mean_m
retained_features.rationale: Euclidean proximity to natural HydroRIVERS stream network.

retained_features.name: dist_to_distributary_min_m
retained_features.rationale: Euclidean distance to active delta distributary branches downstream of Naraj bifurcation.

retained_features.name: strahler_order_max
retained_features.rationale: Stream hierarchy distinguishing headwater tributaries from trunk carrying discharge.

retained_features.name: land_water_dry_fraction
retained_features.rationale: Proportion of dry terrestrial land within DFO cell; accounts for sub-pixel riparian boundaries.

excluded_features_register.name: rainfall_accum_6h_mm
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: UNAVAILABLE: No retrospective 6-hour rainfall observed locally for DFO 3382.

excluded_features_register.name: rainfall_accum_24h_mm
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: UNAVAILABLE: No retrospective daily precipitation observed locally for DFO 3382.

excluded_features_register.name: rainfall_accum_72h_mm
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: UNAVAILABLE: No retrospective antecedent rainfall observed locally for DFO 3382.

excluded_features_register.name: elevation_std_m
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: HIGH_MULTICOLLINEARITY: r = 0.958 with slope_mean_deg; redundant sub-pixel slope proxy.

excluded_features_register.name: elevation_min_m
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: EXTREME_COLLINEARITY: r = 0.999 with elevation_mean_m.

excluded_features_register.name: elevation_max_m
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: EXTREME_COLLINEARITY: r = 0.999 with elevation_mean_m.

excluded_features_register.name: elevation_median_m
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: EXTREME_COLLINEARITY: r = 0.999 with elevation_mean_m.

excluded_features_register.name: profile_curvature_mean
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: HIGH_MULTICOLLINEARITY: r = -0.969 with elevation_mean_m in regional mosaic.

excluded_features_register.name: flow_accum_log10_mean
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: REDUNDANCY: Collinear with flow_accum_log10_max; peak flow accumulation is more physically diagnostic.

excluded_features_register.name: dist_to_river_min_m
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: REDUNDANCY: Collinear with dist_to_river_mean_m.

excluded_features_register.name: strahler_order_rep
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: REDUNDANCY: Collinear with strahler_order_max.

excluded_features_register.name: historical_flood_frequency
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: LEAKAGE_RISK: Encodes historical labels across multiple years; violates single-event independence.

excluded_features_register.name: dfo_cell_id
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: IDENTIFIER: Non-predictive spatial hash.

excluded_features_register.name: grid_row
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: COORDINATE_LEAKAGE: Artificial spatial grid coordinate.

excluded_features_register.name: grid_col
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: COORDINATE_LEAKAGE: Artificial spatial grid coordinate.

excluded_features_register.name: latitude
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: COORDINATE_MEMORIZATION: Would induce spatial memorization rather than physical feature learning.

excluded_features_register.name: longitude
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: COORDINATE_MEMORIZATION: Would induce spatial memorization rather than physical feature learning.

excluded_features_register.name: gfd_flooded_raw
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: TARGET_LEAKAGE: Direct raw sensor observation used to construct label.

excluded_features_register.name: gfd_duration
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: TARGET_LEAKAGE: Encodes flood duration.

excluded_features_register.name: gfd_clear_views
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: QUALITY_METRIC: Used strictly for observation filtering, not hazard prediction.

excluded_features_register.name: gfd_clear_perc
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: QUALITY_METRIC: Optical view fraction used for quality filtering.

excluded_features_register.name: gfd_jrc_perm_water
excluded_features_register.exclusion_reason: TARGET_LEAKAGE: Permanent water mask used for ground truth exclusion.
